* CLASSIFICATION: TMNL-INTERNAL

* META: Document Template Library
** Purpose
Standardized formats for operational documentation, technical specifications,
and intelligence products within the TMNL ecosystem.

** Usage
Copy relevant template sections. Replace bracketed placeholders.
Maintain classification headers and document control footers.

* TEMPLATE: RECONTEXTUALIZATION (Session Handoff)
#+BEGIN_SRC markdown
# [DATE] — [TAGLINE]

## Context

[1-2 sentences: What triggered this session, what state we inherited]

- **Strategy chosen**: [Key decision made]
- **Approach**: [How we executed]

## Changes

### [Primary Change Category]

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `path/to/file` | [What changed] |

### [Secondary Change Category] (if applicable)

[Details of secondary changes]

## Lessons

1. **[Lesson title]**: [Explanation]
2. **[Lesson title]**: [Explanation]

## Verification

- `[command]` — [Result]
- [Other verification steps]

---

## Ideas Parking Lot

Threads surfaced. Captured before they evaporate.

### [Category 1]

| Item | Status | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| [Item name] | [Not started/Partial/Complete] | [Context] |

### [Category 2]

| Item | Status | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| [Item name] | [Status] | [Context] |

[Repeat for all categories with pending work]

---

## Signature

```
Co-Authored-By: [Agent] <[email]>
```
#+END_SRC

** Usage Notes
- Create in =.agents/[agent]/journal/[YYYY-MM-DD].md=
- Tagline should be memorable, captures session essence
- Ideas Parking Lot prevents context loss across sessions
- Categories should map to architectural domains (Animation, Components, etc.)
- Status values: Not started | Partial | Complete | Blocked | Deferred

** When to Generate
- End of significant work session
- Before anticipated context window exhaustion
- After completing multi-step tasks
- When surfacing forgotten threads

* TEMPLATE: AGENTS SECTION (ZON)
#+BEGIN_SRC org
,* AGENTS                                                           :noexport:
#+BEGIN_ZON
type:manifest
version:1.0.0
audience:machine
visibility:folded
#+END_ZON

,** CONTEXT INDEX
#+BEGIN_ZON
id:ctx-index
type:registry
updated:[YYYY-MM-DD]
#+END_ZON

#+BEGIN_ZON @contexts
contexts:@(N):id,path,scope,priority
[context-id],[path/to/file.md],[session|task|ephemeral],[1-10]
#+END_ZON

,** DIRECTIVES
#+BEGIN_ZON
id:ctx-directives
type:instructions
#+END_ZON

,*** [Directive Name]
#+BEGIN_ZON
trigger:[command or event]
scope:[session|task|ephemeral]
action:[action-id]
#+END_ZON

[Directive description in prose]

,** MACHINE SCHEMA
#+BEGIN_ZON
id:ctx-schema
format:[typescript|json|zon]
#+END_ZON

#+BEGIN_SRC [language]
// Schema definition
#+END_SRC
#+END_SRC

** Usage Notes
- Add to any org document that needs machine-parseable metadata
- ZON format: ~key:value~ for properties, ~@(N):cols~ for tables
- Booleans: ~T~ / ~F~
- Scopes: ~session~ (full conversation), ~task~ (current operation), ~ephemeral~ (single read)
- Priority: 1-10, higher = load first

** ZON Reference
- Specification: https://zonformat.org/docs/specification
- Token-efficient: 35-50% reduction vs JSON
- Line-oriented, human-readable, LLM-optimized

| Level        | Meaning                                    |
|--------------+--------------------------------------------|
| TMNL-PUBLIC  | Unrestricted, external sharing permitted   |
| TMNL-INTERNAL| Internal use only, team members            |
| TMNL-RESTRICTED | Need-to-know basis                      |
| TMNL-PRIME   | Prime's eyes only                          |
